title: Expositions of Holy Scripture
author: Alexander Maclaren
tradition_notes: Maclaren was a Baptist minister at Union Chapel, Manchester (1858-1903) and president of the Baptist World Alliance (1905). His expositions are evangelical and broadly Reformed, emphasising scripture, grace, and union with Christ. His careful exegetical work influenced both Baptist and wider evangelical preaching traditions.
source_edition: Project Gutenberg digitisations of 15 volumes (Hodder & Stoughton, 1892-1910). All PG IDs listed in raw/gutenberg/sermons/PG_SERMON_INVENTORY.md.
notes: 1263 expositions across 15 volumes covering Genesis through the General Epistles. Maclaren died 1910 -- text is public domain. PG volumes: 7069, 8068, 7883, 7925, 8069, 15836, 7351, 8071, 8200, 8070, 8381, 8397, 13601, 21190, 24674.
